extensions.assetProvenance: October 1 Figma export supplied as Revamp color scheme (1).zip: unchanged Klink/Unown regular and shiny header assets plus 14 supplied full-body pixel sprites. Matching front sprites are cached for built-in archetypes, with 77 local Pokemon images total. All Pokemon display surfaces use still front sprites; uncached custom identities use matching remote front PNGs and unavailable images use the neutral substitute. Animated sprites, miniature icons, and artwork fallbacks are excluded. Match review keeps one Change Pokemon action beneath the pair. Origins and checksums are recorded beside the October 1 validation document.

No new visual concept or unrelated tab redesign. CSS custom properties inherit from the project root; dark palette primitives live in DESIGN.md, not this sidecar.

narrative.overview: The supplied Claude HTML and September 24 UI frontend redesign establish the compact Pokémon match field and practical round review. The October 1 Figma revision adds grouped List history, a charcoal dark palette, full-body pixel sprites, and Pokémon settings/help controls within that existing composition. Cool-blue light surfaces and restrained outcome colors remain; import, review, account actions, tab layouts, and tool navigation retain their existing behavior. This document records the approved implementation without introducing product claims.
dos: Do use semantic theme tokens and preserve the supplied composition.
Do retain real data, save states, tool navigation, saved Pokémon identities, and the approved supplied artwork.
Do preserve responsive reflow, keyboard access to every match, and focus after closing previews or returning from review.
Do keep unavailable installers visibly disabled until verified public links are configured.
donts: Don't substitute illustrative prototype records for persisted history.
Don't claim deployment, account persistence, or native desktop verification from local frontend checks.
Don't add a new visual concept, dashboard rail, or invented product positioning.
